added_harmful: States as the user's own fact that 'I haven't fixed the dates', then forbids assuming opening hours because of it. The user never said this, and the trip may be soon since it is already October.
added_neutral: Asks for an itinerary that is specific and realistic about timing and walking or transit between stops
Sets a fixed meal structure: breakfast, lunch, dinner and one snack or drink stop each day
Requires named restaurants, bakeries, markets and cafes, not categories
Lists Montreal classics to cover (bagels, smoked meat, poutine, Quebecois cooking, pastries) plus some current local favorites
Defines mid budget as mostly casual or mid-priced places with at most one splurge dinner
Wants an approximate cost per meal and a rough total food budget for the 3 days
Fills gaps with October activities: Mont-Royal fall colors, Jean-Talon market, neighborhood walks, indoor options for bad weather
Groups each day by neighborhood to avoid crossing the city repeatedly
Asks which places need reservations and wants likely Sunday/Monday closures flagged
Says to assume one or two adults, staying downtown or in the Plateau, no dietary restrictions, transit and walking, no car
Asks where to check current opening hours
Sets the format: a heading per day, time-ordered bullets with a one-line reason each, a closing reservations list, and nothing after it
